sobre-mi.title: About me
sobre-mi.texto_sobreMi:
Junior Software Developer passionate about technology and modern web development. I have knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Java, .NET, and SQL Server databases, which allows me to develop functional and attractive solutions.
I am interested in continuing to grow professionally in the frontend and backend development field by creating dynamic and responsive digital applications. I consider myself a responsible and creative person with a strong capacity for continuous learning, allowing me to adapt to new technologies and professional challenges.
